Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties
Beans for the resources described by the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT) version 3: catalogs, datasets, dataset series, distributions and data services, along with the agents, contact points and concepts they refer to. The beans are independent of the serialization of the DCAT document.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DcatAgent
    DcatAgent describes the person or organization (foaf:Agent) that publishes or creates a resource.
    DcatCatalog
    DcatCatalog describes a curated collection of metadata about datasets and data services (dcat:Catalog).
    DcatConcept
    DcatConcept describes a controlled value used in a DCAT description, such as a theme (skos:Concept), a licence (dct:LicenseDocument) or a media type.
    DcatContactPoint
    DcatContactPoint describes who to contact about a resource (vcard:Kind).
    DcatDataService
    DcatDataService describes a collection of operations that provides access to one or more datasets (dcat:DataService).
    DcatDataset
    DcatDataset describes a collection of data that is published or curated by a single agent (dcat:Dataset).
    DcatDatasetSeries
    DcatDatasetSeries describes a collection of datasets that are published separately but share characteristics that group them (dcat:DatasetSeries).
    DcatDistribution
    DcatDistribution describes a specific representation of a dataset (dcat:Distribution) such as a downloadable file or an access point.
    DcatDocument
    DcatDocument holds the resources described in a single DCAT document.
    DcatPeriodOfTime
    DcatPeriodOfTime describes a temporal period covered by a dataset (dct:PeriodOfTime).
    DcatResource
    DcatResource holds the properties that are common to the resources described in a DCAT catalog (dcat:Resource): datasets, dataset series, data services and the catalogs themselves.
